checklist_covers_all_required_steps: 1. PyPI: create new project-scoped token (scope: Project: autodev-ai)
2. GitHub: gh secret set PYPI_API_TOKEN via stdin pipe (printf '%s' | gh secret set; no argv, no echo, no file write)
3. PyPI: revoke OLD token (burns the chat-leaked credential)
4. Verify on next tag push that twine upload uses new token (CI gate)
checklist_anti_patterns_documented: Do NOT paste new token into chat
Do NOT write token to any file
Do NOT use gh secret set --body '<token>' (token in argv briefly)
Do NOT skip revocation of old token
